whatTheChangeActuallyDoes: New migration creating member_otp_codes (phone_hash + code_hash + code_salt ONLY -- no plaintext column exists; expires_at CHECK <= requested_at + 10 min; attempt_count 0..5; single-use via consumed_at) and member_sessions (user_id + member_person bare uuids, expires_at CHECK <= issued_at + 8h, revoked-not-deleted, immutable binding), with the F1 parameter block (6-digit CSPRNG, salted sha256, <=5 attempts, <=3/hr per phone, <=10/hr per IP, 8h session, device binding explicitly dropped, SIM-swap recorded accepted risk) and four pure gates: member_otp_throttle, member_otp_verify_gate (replay > expiry > lock), member_session_valid (session expiry AND member_access_expires_at), member_invite_identity_ok (F2: mismatch is forgery, 403, never overwritten). Conditional directus_users re-ensure (ADD COLUMN IF EXISTS, 0005 owns the columns). directus_app ceiling grants (INSERT + counter/revoke UPDATE only, no binding/hash/expiry UPDATE, no DELETE). Rollback refuses while rows exist. Suite 75 pins schema, all four gate matrices, creation-time rejections, guards, rerun. Portal: member-otp util (F1 constants, CSPRNG via randomInt, timing-safe compare, generic ack), request route (phone-only, same ack on every path incl. throttle), verify route (phone+code only, single 401 choke point, consume-before-issue, server-side person<-people-by-phone + user<-member_person binding, sealed member session role=member), member profile route (member-only 403 otherwise, session personId only, redacted projection, no internals). All three routes 503 member_otp_disabled unless NUXT_MEMBER_OTP_ENABLED=true; nuxt.config default false. No passwords anywhere; staff MFA untouched. Shared role-matrix/collections/types untouched (member grants live in the Directus policy only).
